assertions: Entry CSS imports Tailwind via @import "tailwindcss"; and contains no @tailwind directives
Brand color #4f46e5 is defined inside a top-level @theme block as a --color-* variable (not nested under a selector, not defined only in :root)
The brand color literal #4f46e5 appears exactly once across all deliverables (single source of truth)
Markup applies the brand via a generated utility class or var(--color-...) reference rather than a hardcoded hex
prompt: Set up the styling foundation for a new marketing page: an index.html with a simple hero section (headline, subheadline, one CTA button) plus the Tailwind v4 entry CSS file. Brand color is #4f46e5; we also need a neutral surface tone for the page background. The brand color must be set up so we can change it in one place later and every use across the site follows.
